draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for flagging the duplicate charge -- your ticket is still open and with our billing team, and Tariq will follow up there directly.

In the meantime, I don't want the setup side to stall. You've created your first project, and in Wrenfield projects are the main organizing unit with tasks living inside them. I also see one invite has gone out; teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if more of the Blue Partners team is joining.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the next step with you.

Best,
Priya
